text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
“—What's this?
Not coming, little mouse?”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Then... this is the end.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......!!
Damn it, damn it... damn it......!! Why!
Why is it like this......!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It's so bright......—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She showed the sheer pride of a Triple Crown Umamusume!
The victor is Orfevre!
The dream reaches toward the world...!!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Heheheh.
Fools.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haa... pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
...I lost...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it.
Orfe-san really is... incredible.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, you really are...
my...—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Win Variation.
Hasten to my side.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh, wha...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes of yours.
—Did you truly think I wouldn't notice?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Insolent bloodlust seeking to overthrow me... How utterly presumptuous.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However,
it was only you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Those who continue to glare at my throne.
—Even now.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Your eyes are ablaze.
...Don't you dare let that repulsive fire die out before I return.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You say whatever you want... and just stir up other people's feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Like hell I'd let it die out.
You idiot...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Unstoppable, as expected...! It's Orfevre! Orfevre reigns supreme!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's gonna make our dreams come true!
We're counting on you at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe~~!!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre...!
We dedicate our hearts to you...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With little time to bask in the afterglow of victory, massive expectations
were directed at Orfevre... As if taking it all in,
she gazed across the grandstands—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Hear me, my people.
Do not let your fervor die out! Fuel the flames! And then—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Await the light
that I shall bring.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You all shall surely
witness it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward that distant summit, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...
Japan's strongest Umamusume, Orfevre, marches forth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We'll also need to get the secret preparations for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe fully underway.
We must strengthen our coordination with URA officials, too.
choice_data_list: Once we're back, it'll be the Japan Cup, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As an international invitational race, the Japan Cup brings together the strongest Umamusume from home and abroad. Let's prepare a plan to greet them as the reigning champion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The mysterious gold pendant I acquired last New Year's... Thinking of Orfevre's future, I clasp it tightly with a wish in my heart.
choice_data_list: (The one who will win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... is Orfevre!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—That night, I had a dream.
No, it wasn't a dream..."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's dream has vanished right before the finish line...!
Orfevre finishes in 2nd place!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre suffers defeat at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
It was a harsh—'reality.'"
